title: Compatibility interpreter
deliverable: Complete execution of imported reference recipe sequences using the bounded control-flow IR.
acceptance: Recipes with disabled operations, defaults and mixed data types preserve documented semantics.

title: Fork and Merge compatibility
deliverable: Map reference branch/delimiter behavior to typed graph regions and ordered joins.
acceptance: Empty branches, delimiters and nested forks match fixtures independently of runtime chunking.

title: Subsection processing
deliverable: Add bounded subsequence selection and reinsertion with exact offset/text semantics.
acceptance: Boundary, Unicode and changing-output-length cases preserve the required surrounding data.

title: Registers and variables
deliverable: Implement reference register capture/substitution plus typed native variables and secret references.
acceptance: Scope, escaping, missing registers and lifetime rules are deterministic; secrets do not leak into recipe serialization.

title: Labels and jumps
deliverable: Deliver forward/backward and conditional jumps with explicit iteration and total-work limits.
acceptance: Looping reference fixtures pass; exhausted limits return a precise diagnostic rather than hang.

title: Return and nested recipes
deliverable: Add early return, comments, subrecipe calls and reusable parameterized recipe blocks.
acceptance: Return scopes and nested budget inheritance are tested; recursion is bounded or rejected by the declared profile.

title: Compatibility recipe importer
deliverable: Import supported JSON and URL recipe encodings into the canonical model with a diagnostic report.
acceptance: Unknown operations/arguments are preserved for review or rejected, never silently dropped.

title: Compatibility exporter
deliverable: Export representable recipes to the reference format and native full-fidelity format.
acceptance: Unrepresentable graph features produce an explicit report; no misleading successful export loses behavior.

title: Detection primitives
deliverable: Add versioned signature, alphabet, entropy and structure detectors with bounded sampling.
acceptance: Detectors explain evidence and uncertainty; a score is not advertised as a calibrated probability without validation.

title: Magic one-step suggestions
deliverable: Suggest candidate reversible transforms and display previews without changing the active recipe.
acceptance: Suggestions require user acceptance; network, secret-revealing or expensive actions are excluded by default.

title: Magic bounded search
deliverable: Add multi-layer transform search with deduplication, depth/work budgets and reproducible ranking.
acceptance: Adversarial recursive inputs terminate; repeated runs on the same data/revision produce stable candidate ordering.

title: Brute-force analysis
deliverable: Complete required XOR/rotation/encoding/language-scoring searches and ranked result presentation.
acceptance: Work estimates, candidate limits and cancellation are effective; heavy searches are never automatic by default.

title: Full regex compatibility
deliverable: Close remaining XRegExp/JavaScript syntax, Unicode, capture, replacement and formatting gaps through the approved strategy.
acceptance: Reference dialect corpus passes locally and natively; safe-regex mode remains separately identified.

title: End-to-end reference recipes
deliverable: Run a broad versioned corpus combining formats, crypto, loops, archives, media and forensic operations.
acceptance: Equality criteria cover bytes, structure, diagnostics and allowed nondeterminism; every mismatch has a tracked disposition.

title: Feature-complete parity candidate
deliverable: Reconcile operation, argument, recipe, UI and browser/native matrices against the frozen reference.
acceptance: No required capability is missing; any open gap creates additional 0.x releases before qualification.
